title: Asteroids
prompt:
Build Asteroids on a 640x480 field where everything wraps around the edges. The ship rotates (angle in radians, 0 = facing up, growing clockwise), thrusts along its facing with slight drag and fires bullets that fly at least 300 units. start() spawns 4 large asteroids (size 3) at least 100 units from the ship. Shooting splits size 3 into two size 2 and size 2 into two size 1, and destroys size 1; each hit scores. A collision costs one of 3 lives and respawns the ship at the centre with up to 120 invulnerable ticks (the first ship is not invulnerable); 0 lives ends the game. When no asteroid is left the next, larger wave spawns within 120 ticks. Keyboard: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight rotate, ArrowUp thrusts, Space fires. Touch: hold the left/right third to rotate, the middle third to thrust; every touchstart fires.

Contract (window.Game; implement exactly):
- Game.start(): new game from any phase; phase becomes 'play'
- Game.getState(): {phase:'menu'|'play'|'over', score, lives, wave, width:640, height:480, ship:{x,y,angle,vx,vy}, invulnerable (ticks left), asteroids:[{x,y,r,size}], bullets:[{x,y}]}
- Game.setSeed(n): seed the PRNG behind all randomness (applies at the next start())
- Game.step(n): advance exactly n fixed 1/60 s ticks synchronously
- Game.input.press(name): hold 'left', 'right' or 'thrust'
- Game.input.release(name): release it
- Game.input.fire(): fire a bullet
- Game.debug.setShip(x, y, angle, vx, vy): place the ship
- Game.debug.clearAsteroids(): remove all asteroids
- Game.debug.spawnAsteroid(x, y, size, vx, vy): add an asteroid

Acceptance (checked by Kyora Bench browser tests): rotation, thrust, wrapping, splitting, lives and invulnerability, waves, seeded fields, keyboard and touch.
